remarks: PLEASE SUBMIT HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY NOON, JULY 2nd.  Enjoy living in this turnkey, upgraded 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom in-town townhome. The entry level features an open floor plan offering a kitchen with white cabinets, backsplash and granite countertops along with a bright open living room w/fireplace and dining room for entertaining. Sliders lead to a newer balcony off of the living room and a spacious deck from the kitchen. There are refinished hardwood floors throughout, efficient new windows, sliders, baseboards, trim and an alarm system. The second floor offers 2 bedrooms including a generous primary with spa like luxurious renovated bathroom, featuring double vanity sink, granite countertops, tile floor, oversized shower, soaking tub and laundry space. The second bedroom is ensuite with a double closet. Lower level offers a bonus room that can be used as a gym, playroom or office, connected to the garage. Spacious attic with lots of storage. In-town living at its best. Walk to shopping, park, library, restaurants, train and Norwalk River Valley Trail. Move right in and enjoy the summer by the pool and walking to town!
